$comment: Wave-2 manifest: per-context availability probes. The function matrix itself is derived from src/registry/functions.ts (one registry — rule 8); this file holds only what cannot be derived: invocation overrides for functions whose minimal call needs shaping, the global-variable probes, and the runtime validation-rule probes. Placeholders: {T:Type} resolves to a typed input field on containers that can reference fields, else a literal; {F:Type} requires a real field reference (probe is untestable in containers without fields).

VLOOKUP.$comment: VLOOKUP resolves only custom-object fields, and the match field must be the object's Name field — standard-object references reject with field-does-not-exist.

GEOLOCATION.$comment: A bare GEOLOCATION() has no context-legal standalone position; the pair is probed jointly, conflation marked by taint both ways.

flowValueProbes.question: Wave-3: HTMLENCODE's exact entity set — angle brackets, ampersand, both quote kinds (flows are its only runtime-observable home).
Wave-3: JSENCODE's exact escapes (double quote, apostrophe; a literal backslash is a flow-formula syntax error, so it cannot be probed here).
Wave-3: JSINHTMLENCODE composition order and entity set.
Wave-3: URLENCODE — space as %20 or +, and which reserved characters escape.
Wave-3: div-by-zero surfacing in a running flow — interview error or null?
Wave-3: BR() rendering seen from a flow interview (cross-check the formula-field probe).

runtimeProbes.question: Channel canary: a gated always-true rule must block its own record's insert with our marker message.

interpret.FIRED: channel sound — gated rules fire and the marker survives into the DML error
interpret.SAVED: CHANNEL BROKEN — do not trust any runtime verdict from this run

runtimeProbes.question: Is text = case-sensitive in the validation-rule context (formula fields: yes, org-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: case-INsensitive in validation rules — differs from formula fields

runtimeProbes.question: Does a blank Number compare like 0 in validation rules (which blank mode does the VR context behave as)?

interpret.SAVED: ordering vs blank is false (blank-mode behavior)

runtimeProbes.question: Is blank Number = 0 true in validation rules?

interpret.SAVED: blank numeric = 0 is false (blank-mode behavior, matches corpus three-valued rule)

runtimeProbes.question: Does a blank Text field equal "" in validation rules (formula fields: true, corpus-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: blank text coerces to "" — same as formula fields
interpret.SAVED: blank text does NOT equal "" here — differs from formula fields

runtimeProbes.question: Sanity: ISBLANK on an empty Number fires in a validation rule.

interpret.SAVED: ISBLANK(blank) false in VRs — investigate before trusting blank probes

runtimeProbes.question: How does a runtime #Error! surface in a validation rule: blocked save with a system error, silently false, or rule fired?

interpret.ERR: runtime error surfaces as its own DML failure (capture the message text)
interpret.SAVED: the error is swallowed and the rule is treated as false/skipped

runtimeProbes.question: Does IFERROR catch a div-by-zero inside a validation rule (it is unavailable in formula fields — org-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: IFERROR catches the error and returns the fallback TRUE — rule fires
interpret.SAVED: IFERROR did not catch (or evaluated false)
interpret.ERR: error propagates through IFERROR — it does not catch div-by-zero here

runtimeProbes.question: Does AND short-circuit past a runtime error in its second operand? (Only meaningful if err_divzero shows errors surface.)

interpret.SAVED: AND(FALSE, …) never evaluates the erroring operand (short-circuit) — or errors read as false; disambiguate via err_divzero
interpret.ERR: AND evaluates operands eagerly — the error escapes even under a FALSE guard

runtimeProbes.question: Does OR short-circuit past a runtime error once TRUE is decided?

interpret.FIRED: OR(TRUE, …) fires without evaluating the erroring operand (short-circuit)
interpret.ERR: OR evaluates operands eagerly — the error escapes despite the TRUE
interpret.SAVED: OR(TRUE, …) neither fired nor errored?! — investigate
